Semir Jahic · Updated July 2, 2026 · 11 min read Table of Contents Table of Contents Common Room vs Salesmotion at a Glance Key Takeaways Common Room Pricing Plans in 2026 Hidden Costs and Pricing Gotchas Is Common Room Worth It in 2026? Common Room Alternatives and Competitors Frequently Asked Questions Related Articles See interactive demo Common Room raised its entry price sharply in the past year, and most buyers researching Common Room pricing don't know it yet. The $1,000-per-month Starter tier you'll still find quoted across the web is gone. The published entry point on Common Room's pricing page is now the Essential plan at $2,500 per month, billed annually. That's $30,000 per year before add-ons. 
 This guide breaks down what each Common Room plan costs in 2026, where the credit systems and contact caps push spend higher, and how the platform compares to alternatives built for enterprise account teams rather than community-led motions. 
 Update (July 2, 2026): Zoom announced a definitive agreement to acquire Common Room. Pricing and packaging may change as the product folds into Zoom's revenue platform. Read our full analysis of what the Zoom acquisition means for Common Room customers . 
 
 TL;DR: Common Room pricing starts at $2,500/month billed annually ($30,000/year) for the Essential plan with 5 seats and 100k contacts. Advanced and Enterprise tiers are quote-only, and Vendr's buyer data puts the median contract at about $30,000/year. Costs scale with contacts enriched, credits consumed, and seats, not just team size. Teams that need account intelligence over community-signal aggregation should compare Salesmotion , which starts at $85/mo on a self-serve monthly individual plan with custom team pricing (unlimited users on team plans). 
 
 
 Common Room positions itself as a customer intelligence platform. Its published entry price is $2,500/month billed annually; everything above that tier is quote-only.
